title: Load Calculator Menu Access Repair
notes: Restores Load Calculator / Auto ANFO as a permanent Shot Diagram menu item directly below Timing Sequence.
Binds the calculator action reliably even when the Shot Diagram menu is rebuilt during startup.
Adds a clear document-level Auto ANFO ON/OFF toggle directly inside Hole Entry.
Auto ANFO OFF is manual/emulsion mode and never overwrites stemming or Primary Load while a hole is entered or edited.
Manual Primary Load entries can contain the pumped pounds reported by the emulsion truck.
Keeps the same Auto ANFO setting in the Load Calculator / Auto ANFO parameter window.
Retains automatic stemming and ANFO calculation for manually created, edited, and Drill Log-converted Shot Diagram holes when enabled.
Adds document-level parameters for minimum stemming, hold into rock, and feet occupied per dink.
Defaults to 7 ft minimum stemming, a 1 ft hold into rock, and 3 ft per dink.
Calculates stemming as max(minimum stemming, overburden plus rock hold).
Calculates ANFO as depth minus stemming minus dink footage.
Adds a Load Calculator / Auto ANFO tool with preview, settings-only save, existing-hole recalculation, and undo.
Skips Dirt and Bad holes, non-ANFO Primary Loads, and unsupported mixed Secondary Loads.
Keeps Drill Log conversion connected to the same configurable Shot Diagram rules.
Preserves inferred two-tap timing, Page Order / Renumber, iPad entry layout, right-click shortcuts, and cloud sync behavior.
